name: DividedSplitting.exists_isGlued
summary: Lift s, put [t; ϖ·1] in Hermite form over Ô, build block matrices C, G with C·G = ϖ·1 from it, take the divided lattice of exists_reducedInverse_eq, and check the two conditions of IsGlued modulo M².

steps.claim: Lift s entrywise to integral adeles t (the reduction is surjective).
Hermite form of the stacked matrix [t; ϖ·1_N] over Ô (a valuation-pair ring): an invertible U over Ô and D with the identities P (U·[t; ϖ·1] in echelon form, with lower block U₂₂·D = ϖ·1) and Q.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨U, -, D, -, P, Q⟩ :=
    isValuationPair_Ohat.top.hermite .inr ((of t).fromRows (O.genIntAdele • 1))

steps.claim: Apply exists_reducedInverse_eq to C = (U₂₂, I_fixedEmb·I_zᵀ; 0, diag(1 on z(r), ϖ elsewhere)) and G = (D, −D_fixedEmb·I_zᵀ; 0, diag(ϖ on z(r), 1 elsewhere)), both relabelled by ε: this gives L with L.reducedInverse = G mod M² (e), once C·G = ϖ·1 is checked, using step 3.1.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨L, e⟩ := DividedLattice.exists_reducedInverse_eq (O := O) ((fromBlocks U.1.toBlocks₂₂
    (inclMatrix (Ô E) V.fixedEmb * (inclMatrix (Ô E) z)ᵀ) 0 (.diagonal (if · ∈ Set.range z then 1
    else O.genIntAdele))).reindex V.ε V.ε) ((fromBlocks D (-D.submatrix id V.fixedEmb *
    (inclMatrix (Ô E) z)ᵀ) 0 (.diagonal (if · ∈ Set.range z then O.genIntAdele else 1))).reindex
    V.ε V.ε) (by simp +contextual [← mul_inclMatrix, ← U.1.toBlocks₂₂.mul_assoc,
                   inclMatrix_transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc
                   _ _ᵀ, show U.1.toBlocks₂₂ * D = O.genIntAdele • 1 from congr(toRows₂ $P).symm]
                 simp [entrywise, reindex_equiv V.ε, inclMatrix, diagonal_apply, mul_sum])

steps.claim: U₂₂·D = ϖ·1 (the lower rows of P); with it the block product C·G is ϖ·1 (simp).
steps.lean:
show U.1.toBlocks₂₂ * D = O.genIntAdele • 1 from congr(toRows₂ $P).symm]
                 simp [entrywise, reindex_equiv V.ε, inclMatrix, diagonal_apply, mul_sum])

steps.claim: Reduce P and Q modulo M²: the reduction of t is s.
steps.lean:
apply_fun (·.map O.chosenModulusSq.reduction) at P Q
  simp [map_smul', (Matrix.ext hs : (of t).map O.chosenModulusSq.reduction = s)] at P Q

steps.claim: Take this L. The indicator identity is proved through the intermediate condition 'x_incl = Y⁻¹ and G·x = ϖ̄·I_incl' (steps 6, 7), and the column condition with K from clearing the columns of s outside the divided embedding (exists_mul_clear_cols over O_E/M², a valuation-pair ring) (step 8).
steps.lean:
refine ⟨L, fun x c ↦ .trans ?_ (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun Y _ ↦ if_congr (P := x.submatrix O.incl
    id = Y⁻¹.1 ∧ L.reducedInverse * x = V.genResidue • inclMatrix _ O.incl) ?_ rfl rfl),
    ((isValuationPair_resRing _).exists_mul_clear_cols s V.dividedEmb).imp fun K h ↦ ?_⟩

steps.claim: First: (c if G·x = ϖ̄·I_incl) = Σ_Y (c if x_incl = Y⁻¹ and G·x = ϖ̄·I_incl). If G·x = ϖ̄·I_incl, then ϖ̄·(1 − x_incl) = 0 (from the shape of G, e, ε_ι), so exactly one Y of the congruence group has Y⁻¹ = x_incl (exists_congruenceGroup_inv_eq_one_sub with 1 − x_incl); otherwise both sides are 0.
steps.lean:
· split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]
    have ⟨Y, f⟩ := V.exists_congruenceGroup_inv_eq_one_sub (Y := 1 - x.submatrix O.incl id)
      (Matrix.ext (by simpa [e, ← V.ε_ι, apply_ite, mul_apply, inclMatrix, diagonal_apply,
      mul_sub, reindex_equiv V.ε] using congrFun₂ h.symm <| O.incl ·))
    simp at f; rw [← f]; norm_cast; simp

steps.claim: Second: for each Y, the condition 'x_incl = Y⁻¹ and G·x = ϖ̄·I_incl' is equivalent to the block conditions on X = x·Y of IsGlued. Rewrite with step 7.1, Y·Y⁻¹ = 1 and the congruence property of Y.
steps.lean:
· erw [show ∀ X Y : Matrix N r O.chosenModulusSq.ResRing, V.stackOverGenScalar s * X =
      V.stackOverGenScalar s * Y ↔ D.map O.chosenModulusSq.reduction * X =
      D.map O.chosenModulusSq.reduction * Y by grind [Matrix.mul_assoc, stackOverGenScalar],
      ← Units.mul_eq_one_iff_eq_inv, ← inclMatrix_transpose_mul, ←
      mul_left_inj_of_invertible (m := n) Y.1, smul_mul, ← Matrix.mul_smul,
      (mul_smul_one ..).symm.trans Y.2, Matrix.mul_assoc, L.reducedInverse.mul_assoc]
    generalize x * Y.1.1 = X
    simp +contextual [e, entrywise, reindex_equiv V.ε, ← V.ε_ι, inclMatrix,
      apply_ite O.chosenModulusSq.reduction, diagonal_apply, iff_def, sum_mul, sum_comm]
    grind

steps.claim: For N×r matrices X, Y over O_E/M²: [s; ϖ̄·1]·X = [s; ϖ̄·1]·Y iff D̄·X = D̄·Y (D̄ the reduction of D), by the Hermite identities P, Q modulo M² (grind); then rewrite with inclusion matrices and the invertibility of Y.
steps.lean:
show ∀ X Y : Matrix N r O.chosenModulusSq.ResRing, V.stackOverGenScalar s * X =
      V.stackOverGenScalar s * Y ↔ D.map O.chosenModulusSq.reduction * X =
      D.map O.chosenModulusSq.reduction * Y by grind [Matrix.mul_assoc, stackOverGenScalar],
      ← Units.mul_eq_one_iff_eq_inv, ← inclMatrix_transpose_mul, ←
      mul_left_inj_of_invertible (m := n) Y.1, smul_mul, ← Matrix.mul_smul,
      (mul_smul_one ..).symm.trans Y.2, Matrix.mul_assoc, L.reducedInverse.mul_assoc]
steps.typed_fact: ∀ X Y : Matrix N r O.chosenModulusSq.ResRing, V.stackOverGenScalar s * X =

steps.claim: Unfold G (e), the relabelling by ε (ε_ι), the inclusion matrices and the diagonal blocks entrywise.
steps.lean:
simp +contextual [e, entrywise, reindex_equiv V.ε, ← V.ε_ι, inclMatrix,
      apply_ite O.chosenModulusSq.reduction, diagonal_apply, iff_def, sum_mul, sum_comm]

steps.claim: Third: for the K of step 5, ϖ̄·((columns ε(inl ·) of G)·K)_{xy} = 0 off the divided embedding: unfold G and the relabelling.

It reduces to the vanishing in those columns of ϖ̄ times products of D̄ with the cleared columns of s̄, by Q and the clearing property h, and of ϖ̄·ϖ̄-multiples products vanishing modulo M² (reduction_levelModulus_eq_zero_iff).
steps.lean:
simp +contextual [↓← mul_apply (M := D.map _), ← Q, Matrix.mul_assoc, h, mul_sum, ← map_mul, sq,
    mul_apply (N := fromRows _ _), mul_left_comm V.genResidue, reduction_levelModulus_eq_zero_iff.2,
    mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc V.genResidue]
